verdict.rationale: Vercel's own pricing docs say Sandbox usage is metered across several dimensions, so billing is usage-based rather than flat. Sandboxes also have a configurable timeout (5-minute default) and can be stopped, which caps how long compute runs. Nothing in the evidence states per-second granularity or that only actively used compute is billed, so only the general usage-metered model is shown. Missing for 10: documented per-second billing granularity, evidence that only actual compute is charged (for example, idle time excluded), specific per-unit rates, and independent corroboration.
